personas.name: Young mobile feed scroller
personas.description: Synthetic general-US-news-audience persona (pre-registered Upworthy panel). Early-twenties, gets nearly all news incidentally through a fast-moving social feed on a phone. Low deliberate news-seeking, high feed exposure; quick to tap an emotionally vivid or curiosity-gap headline, quick to swipe past dense or dry ones. Moderate clickbait tolerance — annoyed by obvious bait but still reactive to genuine intrigue. No behavioral rows: this generic panel validates headline rendering and CTR elicitation, not a real persona pipeline.
personas.jtbd: Stay loosely in the loop and be entertained while scrolling, without slowing down for anything that looks like work.

personas.name: Time-pressed working parent
personas.description: Synthetic general-US-news-audience persona (pre-registered Upworthy panel). Thirties-to-forties, juggling work and family, checks news in short bursts between tasks. Pragmatic and skeptical of sensationalism, but responsive to headlines that promise something useful, reassuring, or relevant to family and household life. Lower tolerance for pure clickbait; rewards clarity and perceived payoff. No behavioral rows — generic identity depth by design.
personas.jtbd: Get a quick, trustworthy sense of what matters today in the few minutes available, and skip the noise.
